sentences.text: Zeus -LSB- ˈzju : s -RSB- -LRB- Ζεύς , Zeús , -LSB- zdeǔ̯s -RSB- Modern Δίας , Días -LSB- ˈði.as -RSB- -RRB- is the sky and thunder god in ancient Greek religion , who ruled as king of the gods of Mount Olympus .	Mount Olympus	Mount Olympus	sky	sky father	thunder god	thunder god	ancient Greek religion	ancient Greek religion	king of the gods	king of the gods
His name is cognate with the first element of his Roman equivalent Jupiter .	Jupiter	Jupiter (mythology)	cognate	cognate	Roman	ancient Roman religion	equivalent	interpretatio graeca

His mythologies and powers are similar , though not identical , to those of the Indo-European deities such as Indra , Jupiter , Perun , Thor , and Odin .	Jupiter	Jupiter (mythology)	Indra	Indra	Perun	Perun	Thor	Thor	Odin	Odin

Zeus is the child of Cronus and Rhea , the youngest of his siblings to be born , though sometimes reckoned the eldest as the others required disgorging from Cronus 's stomach .	others	Zeus#Consorts and children	Cronus	Cronus	Rhea	Rhea (mythology)
In most traditions , he is married to Hera , by whom he is usually said to have fathered Ares , Hebe , and Hephaestus .	Hera	Hera	Ares	Ares	Hebe	Hebe (mythology)	Hephaestus	Hephaestus

At the oracle of Dodona , his consort was said to be Dione , by whom the Iliad states that he fathered Aphrodite .	Aphrodite	Aphrodite	oracle	oracle	Dodona	Dodona	Dione	Dione (Titaness/Oceanid)	Iliad	Iliad
Zeus was also infamous for his erotic escapades .

These resulted in many godly and heroic offspring , including Athena , Apollo , Artemis , Hermes , Persephone , Dionysus , Perseus , Heracles , Helen of Troy , Minos , and the Muses .	Apollo	Apollo	Artemis	Artemis	Athena	Athena	Dionysus	Dionysus	Helen of Troy	Helen of Troy	Heracles	Heracles	Hermes	Hermes	Minos	Minos	Persephone	Persephone	Perseus	Perseus

He was respected as an allfather who was chief of the gods and assigned the others to their roles : `` Even the gods who are not his natural children address him as Father , and all the gods rise in his presence . ''	others	Zeus#Consorts and children	allfather	Sky father

He was equated with many foreign weather gods , permitting Pausanias to observe `` That Zeus is king in heaven is a saying common to all men '' .	equated	interpretatio graeca	Pausanias	Pausanias (geographer)
Zeus ' symbols are the thunderbolt , eagle , bull , and oak .	eagle	eagle	bull	bull (mythology)	oak	oak	thunderbolt	thunderbolt
